principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class handles both maintaining a list of shapes and computing their areas, violating the SRP by having more than one responsibility.
principle_violations.suggestion: Create separate classes or functions responsible for maintaining the list of shapes and computing the areas of those shapes.

principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class requires modification to add new shape types, violating the OCP as it is not open for extension without modification.
principle_violations.suggestion: Implement polymorphic behavior where each shape class provides its own area calculation method, allowing AreaCalculator to use these methods without needing to know specific shapes.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
